description: Multi-Repository Context - Generate combined context from multiple repositories for monorepo or microservices analysis
steps: Add --multi-repo flag to CLI for multi-repo analysis mode
Add --add-repo <path> command to add repository to config
Add --remove-repo <path> command to remove repository from config
Add --list-repos command to list configured repositories
Implement combined token count and breakdown
acceptance_criteria: Each repo shows separate token count
Combined total shows token breakdown by repo
verification: Run npm test to verify all tests pass
findings: All acceptance criteria met: 1) --multi-repo flag enables multi-repo analysis mode, 2) --add-repo adds repos to .ctxman/repos.json, 3) --remove-repo removes repos, 4) --list-repos shows configured repos with status indicators, 5) Per-repo token counts displayed with percentage breakdown, 6) Combined total shows aggregated file and token counts, 7) Configuration persisted in .ctxman/repos.json with version, id, path, alias, exclude, and weight fields. Tests pass (1039 total). CLI commands work correctly.
